lineConvention: One-based lines after CRLF-to-LF normalization; a terminal newline creates a final empty display line. SHA-256 and byte count cover UTF-8 text after only CRLF-to-LF normalization. The source file is never rewritten.
coverage: Complete source coverage; thematic grouping only, not complete concept extraction or factual verification.

reviewFlags.title: Incomplete citation provenance
reviewFlags.detail: Image proxy URLs, favicons and labels such as NIST+2 are not claim-level citations. Keep the original text, recover primary references and verify the claims before promoting content.

reviewFlags.title: Repeated and sometimes contradictory explanations
reviewFlags.detail: The corpus is a preserved conversation archive, not a peer-reviewed technical manual. Reconcile repeated answers against canonical definitions while retaining the source passages.

reviewFlags.title: Flattened code and illustrative HTTP examples
reviewFlags.detail: Some code loses line breaks. HTTP/1.1 wire examples must not be presented as universal HTTP/2 or HTTP/3 formats; sample lengths and headers require checking. Repair and execute examples in isolation before publication.

reviewFlags.title: Privacy, policy and current-event claims require primary evidence
reviewFlags.detail: Do not treat legal, regulatory, policy or incident assertions in these passages as verified. Record jurisdiction, publication date and a directly supporting primary source before using them as factual guidance.

reviewFlags.title: Unverified Multiblue product identity
reviewFlags.detail: An earlier passage asserts device capabilities; a later passage says no reliable manufacturer specification or technical manual was established. Preserve both. Bluetooth HID techniques do not establish the identity or specifications of a particular product.

reviewFlags.title: Hardware claims depend on exact variants
reviewFlags.detail: Confirm model, revision, firmware, interfaces, voltage and protocol support using manufacturer documentation. Product families and security demonstrations must not be treated as interchangeable specifications.

reviewFlags.title: Security material needs scoped learning context
reviewFlags.detail: Derived practical material must describe owned or explicitly authorized labs and defensive validation. Preserve distinctions between network interception, valid TLS, endpoint compromise and phishing.

reviewFlags.title: Runtime and framework behavior must be qualified
reviewFlags.detail: Distinguish hardware threads, operating-system threads and JavaScript agents. Validate event-loop and middleware behavior against the relevant runtime/framework version; avoid universal timing or browser-process claims.
